en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a sandy forest path on a hill, with several children standing on the path in the foreground and a group of people silhouetted on the hilltop in the distance. Dense trees line both sides of the path. Printed Dutch text appears at the top, and handwritten cursive text is written across the bottom. A small imprint with publisher information and number is in the lower left corner.
